provenance_note: Commit identifies the base checkout; code and data SHA-256 identify the actual dirty/untracked working files. Timestamp is a local freeze record, not external preregistration certification.

A.name: NO-compression-calibration
A.definition: Target supplies only basic metadata and a pre-declared dense capability measurement. No target compressed results enter prediction. Tests basic-parameter prediction.

B.name: FEW-compression-calibration
B.definition: Mode A information plus exactly ONE pre-specified compressed configuration of that target per arm (three capability losses from that configuration). Tests the value of one calibration point; it is not zero-compression prediction.
inputs: one target compressed L_c at the frozen calibration coordinate

transport_scope.source: New checkpoint; Qwen3 8B extends the development Qwen3 size ladder (0.6/1.7/4B). Family and native-token loss may confound transfer.
transport_scope.student: Default Gemma3 12B/D300 is an untested configuration and extrapolates beyond the three development student sizes; D300 is within the dev budget grid. Teacher, recipe and LoRA mode held fixed. No independent student-size coefficient is claimed.

metadata.N0_definition: Non-embedding 2-D language weights: V6 n_params minus token embedding and separately stored output head. Excludes 1-D norm/bias parameters and non-language towers; never substitutes nominal size or embedding-inclusive count. Target uses the identical matrix convention.

measurement.unit: completion-token CE nats, sum NLL / sum target tokens; native tokenizer; v6 completion_loss
measurement.cost: One dense forward-only measurement panel, 64 items per capability; no gradients/Fisher/geometry inputs.
measurement.limitations: Historical native-token endpoints are not tokenizer-invariant per-byte losses. V6/V10 own dense anchors differ slightly; they are preserved arm by arm. Raw archived aggregates do not certify exact checkpoint revisions or text hashes; later dense/calibration inputs must declare their revision and this protocol.

protocol.pruning_recipe: V6 global sampled-threshold magnitude pruning, language matrices including embeddings/head
protocol.quantization_recipe: V10 symmetric per-output-channel fake weight quantization, language matrices including embeddings/head
protocol.outcome_filter: none; fixed coordinates, signed deltas; no cliff/sign filtering
protocol.dev_split: leave ONE entire model out, separately per capability; same score cells for A and B; B calibration cells excluded from scores
protocol.interval: central 95% empirical signed LOMO residual offsets, separately per arm/capability/mode/coordinate. Descriptive prediction intervals; 12 source models or 3 student sizes, no finite-sample coverage guarantee, no item/seed/dense-measurement uncertainty. Distillation unseen budgets use all LOMO budget residuals with explicit extrapolation flag.
protocol.gain_interval: 2000 paired model-bootstrap draws of fixed OOF errors, seed 280906; positive A MAE minus B MAE means one point helped

learnable_on_dev: per-capability shared pruning gamma and signed dev amplitudes
ridge mappings from log N0, family and dense L_c to pruning a and quantization q/1024
distillation math/QA mean response and code log-data coefficient

B: one signed pruning amplitude (gamma stays dev-frozen)

not_identifiable_from_one_point: target pruning gamma independently of amplitude

candidate_only.D0_pretraining_tokens: NOT added: sparse commercial size ladders cannot separate N from D0 effects. Disclosed tokens/stage are recorded as metadata, not fitted covariates; no identifiable independent token/stage effect is established.
candidate_only.training_stage: metadata only; unknown development stages are not imputed
